notes: Local loading becomes Upload in the back,an incorrect network direction.
Loaded local drawing becomes uploaded drawing in the back.
Unitless becomes Non-singular,a different mathematical concept.
Puzzle solution becomes Decision,wrong sense of Russian решение.
No file upload needed becomes no need to download files.
Audio pitch becomes Altitude in the back;this error is separate from the forward lower-level mistranslation.
No upload becomes never loaded,and generic audio decoding is narrowed to decryption.
Recording uploaded becomes recording loaded,losing the privacy/network question.
Ready to download becomes ready for upload,opposite transfer direction.
Recording uploaded becomes recording loaded,losing the privacy/network question.
Generic format decoding is narrowed to decryption;the Russian broad decoding verb does not require encryption.
Semitones become polonium/poloniums;the model back also changes audio pitch to altitude.
Voice becomes political vote in the back.
Count is rendered номер(identifier),not количество;the report is by entity type and count.
CAD entities become субъекты(subjects),wrong technical domain.
Drawing bounds/extents become Рисование границ,the action of drawing borders.
CAD entities become Организации(organizations).
Record-count limit becomes предел записи,a write/individual-record limit;export instruction is an awkward noun fragment.
Required software identifier loglevel is omitted;MIT alone does not identify the licensed library.
Shown CAD entities become Показанные субъекты(subjects).
Mils(thousandths of an inch) become Миля(mile),a different length unit.
Free browser tool becomes Бесплатный браузер(free browser);the product is not a web browser.
Unsupported objects are excluded from exports,not from оценка экспорта(export evaluation/estimation).
Свежая доска is a literal fresh-board calque in generated-grid copy;needs natural wording for a new game board.
ровно один цифровой подсказку has incorrect gender/case agreement;the numeric rule itself is preserved.
Covered grid squares become Крытые площади(indoor/roofed areas),losing the grid-square concept.
Нажмите клавишу Tab на квадрат is malformed and does not state Tab navigation to a square clearly.
The rule-reference title keeps Shikaku but omits rules.
Feminine другую refers to another clue;the source overlap is with another rectangle(masculine).
Numeric rectangle areas become regions(области),not площади.
Rectangle areas are numeric площади,not области(regions);the instruction loses the area-value sense.
Шикаку прямоугольник головоломка is an ungrammatical stack of uninflected nouns.
Свободно играть says freely play rather than that play is free of charge.
глубокий голос эффект has English noun order;частный means private ownership rather than confidentiality.
Required literal Web Audio identifier is translated into веб-аудиофильтры;this is an identifier-contract defect,not a claim that Russian transliteration is grammatically invalid.
Lower-pitch preset becomes a lower level(уровень),changing pitch into output level.
Vocals become a generic audio track;the specific vocal-isolation limitation is lost.
Audio rendering/file generation becomes звуковое отображение(sound display).
Generic preset is left in English in Эффект preset;it is not a protected brand/identifier.
Vocals become a generic audio track;the specific vocal-isolation limitation is lost.
Audio rendering/file generation becomes звуковое отображение(sound display).
Rendering processed audio becomes displaying it,an incorrect processing stage.
Audio output level becomes Уровень выпуска(release/production level).
Просмотрите…,настроить…,и экспорт WAV-файл mixes imperative,infinitive and noun with broken case;the actions remain identifiable.
Voice identity becomes самобытность(originality);полнометражные песни is an inappropriate film-length collocation.
Voice changer becomes a voice manager,losing the changing action in the tool name.
Voice Changer Online remains in English;these generic function words are not a protected brand.
